label: About
title: About The Fracture Keeps Its Depth
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 6 recent saved-signal files and 6 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @oldirtypixel: inhumanely and @bis__cut: we are making 111k images, plus 4 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Fracture Keeps Its Depth: On warm ivory, two unequal fractured pigment clusters flank a channel. The larger bears a violet dome, paired dark hollows and ivory blades; the smaller, a violet-blue fold. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Violet-gray dome and paired black hollows, Curled violet fold with a blue interior and fractured ivory chips, and Green-blue branching ridge with orange and pink accents.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
